brief:
Drop Site News reported that dental materials have been barred from entering Gaza for the past three years, dismantling routine dental care across the territory. Patients now face a choice between unaffordable treatment, tooth extraction, or reliance on painkillers as the sole available option for managing dental conditions.

The restrictions on medical supplies extend beyond dental materials, affecting broader healthcare delivery. The blockade has forced Palestinians to resort to extractions as a primary response to dental emergencies when preventive care and treatment become economically or physically inaccessible.
dek: Along with other medical supplies, dental materials have not been allowed into Gaza for the past three years, forcing patients to choose between unaffordable treatment, extraction, or painkillers.
title: Israel's blockade destroys dental care system in Gaza for three years
